title: xo inbox section policy (~/.quirq/inbox/policy/<section>.json)
description: What a section of the Inbox does with its work items (docs/work-and-workitems.md section 18): whether and when a session starts, what a session may do, how long the sidecars of closed items stay. Written by services/work/items.py and hand-editable; a value out of range falls back to its default on read. Missing altogether, the defaults apply: connections start a session for every new item (mode auto), the other sections wait for a person (manual); every section drafts only.

kinds.description: auto: only facts of these kinds start a session; empty means every kind

act.description: may a session act on the source (send, label)?

retention_days.description: the sidecars of a work item closed longer ago than this are removed; the work item stays
